import copy,hashlib,json,os,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path.cwd(); FOLDER=ROOT/'task_memory/task_2026-10-23_v4_remaining_measurements/profile01/scope_lifetime'
BEFORE='272db0bdf9f8268dd21359ac32c2193354aca910'
def sha(data): return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
def git(*args): return subprocess.check_output(['git',*args],cwd=ROOT,text=True).strip()
def snapshot(path):
    first=path.stat(); data=path.read_bytes(); second=path.stat()
    fields=('st_dev','st_ino','st_size','st_mtime_ns','st_ctime_ns')
    assert all(getattr(first,key)==getattr(second,key) for key in fields), path
    return dict(sha256=sha(data),bytes=len(data),stat={key:getattr(second,key) for key in fields})
def open_handles(targets):
    found=[]
    for proc in Path('/proc').iterdir():
        if not proc.name.isdecimal(): continue
        try: fds=list((proc/'fd').iterdir())
        except FileNotFoundError: continue
        for fd in fds:
            try: target=os.readlink(fd)
            except FileNotFoundError: continue
            if target in targets: found.append(dict(pid=proc.name,fd=fd.name,target=target))
    return found
records={}
for name in ('hash_receipt.json','commands.json'):
    path=FOLDER/name; data=path.read_bytes(); relative=str(path.relative_to(ROOT))
    baseline=subprocess.check_output(['git','show',BEFORE+':'+relative],cwd=ROOT)
    assert data==baseline
    records[name]=dict(sha256=sha(data),git_blob=git('rev-parse',BEFORE+':'+relative),content=data.decode())
receipt=json.loads(records['hash_receipt.json']['content']); command=json.loads(records['commands.json']['content'])
retained=command['retained_raw_artifacts']; paths={name:Path(row['path']) for name,row in retained.items()}
assert not open_handles({str(path.resolve()) for path in paths.values()})
first={name:snapshot(path) for name,path in paths.items()}
comparisons=[]
for name,row in retained.items():
    actual=first[name]['sha256']; embedded=sha(row['content'].encode())
    assert embedded==actual
    comparisons.append(dict(record='commands.json',name=name,recorded=row['sha256'],closed=actual))
for name,expected in receipt['raw_evidence'].items():
    comparisons.append(dict(record='hash_receipt.json',name=name,recorded=expected,closed=first[name]['sha256']))
bad=[row for row in comparisons if row['recorded']!=row['closed']]
assert len(comparisons)==26 and len(bad)==1 and bad[0]['name']=='validate_final.log'
headers={name:sha(paths[name].read_bytes().splitlines(keepends=True)[0]) for name in ('validate.log','validate_final.log')}
assert headers['validate_final.log']==bad[0]['recorded']
archive=dict(task_id='W128-SCOPE-LIFETIME-SOURCE',before_commit=BEFORE,original_records=records,all_before_bindings=comparisons,
             mismatch=bad[0],process_header_sha256=headers,diagnostic_limit='fuser unavailable; replaced by direct read-only /proc descriptor inspection; no environment edit')
with (FOLDER/'closed_log_binding_before.json').open('x') as handle: json.dump(archive,handle,indent=2); handle.write('\n')
source={}
for relative,expected in receipt['source_test_sha256'].items():
    path=ROOT/relative; assert sha(path.read_bytes())==expected
    source[relative]=dict(sha256=expected,gross_lines=len(path.read_text().splitlines()))
assert [row['gross_lines'] for row in source.values()]==[250,160]
assert len(receipt['seven_inputs'])==7 and len(receipt['runtime_modules_13'])==13
for row in receipt['seven_inputs']:
    path=ROOT/row['path']; assert sha(path.read_bytes())==row['sha256'] and path.stat().st_size==row['bytes']
for relative,row in receipt['runtime_modules_13'].items(): assert sha((ROOT/relative).read_bytes())==row['sha256']
for relative,expected in receipt['record_bindings'].items(): assert sha((ROOT/relative).read_bytes())==expected
inventory=json.loads((FOLDER.parent/'profile04/hash_inventory.json').read_text())
assert inventory['files']==receipt['sealed_package_45_binding_only'] and len(inventory['files'])==45
matrix=json.loads((ROOT/receipt['existing_matrix_binding']).read_text()); assert matrix==receipt['matrix']
assert matrix['identical_cases']==77 and matrix['mismatched_cases']==0 and not matrix['new_capture']
for domain,tree in matrix['unchanged_domain_trees'].items(): assert git('rev-parse','HEAD:'+domain)==tree
for name,path in paths.items(): assert snapshot(path)==first[name]
assert not open_handles({str(path.resolve()) for path in paths.values()})
corrected=copy.deepcopy(receipt); corrected['raw_evidence']={name:first[name]['sha256'] for name in receipt['raw_evidence']}
with (FOLDER/'hash_receipt.json').open('w') as handle: json.dump(corrected,handle,indent=2); handle.write('\n')
code=FOLDER/'closed_log_hash_receipt.json'
record=dict(task_id='W128-SCOPE-LIFETIME-SOURCE',status='PASS_POST_PROCESS_RAW_HASH_CLOSURE',before_commit=BEFORE,python=sys.version,
            verification_source=SOURCE,verification_source_sha256=sha(SOURCE.encode()),
            verification_command="sudo -n systemd-run --scope -p MemoryMax=30G timeout 60s /data/ycfeng/envs/asyncopd-py312/bin/python -B - <<'PY'\nSOURCE = r\x27\x27\x27"+SOURCE+"\x27\x27\x27\nexec(compile(SOURCE, '<closed-log-postprocess-audit>', 'exec'))\nPY",
            writer_check='Direct /proc/*/fd inspected before/after; no retained artifact descriptors; stable dev/ino/size/mtime/ctime and two equal byte hashes',
            retained_raw_artifacts=first,all_before_bindings=comparisons,corrected_binding=bad[0],
            initial_validator_same_self_hash_pattern=True,initial_validator_current_bindings_match_closed_file=True,
            observed_prefix_hash=headers['validate_final.log'],authoritative_log_sha256={name:first[name]['sha256'] for name in receipt['raw_evidence']},
            source_test=source,immutable_input_count=7,unchanged_local_runtime_count=13,unchanged_package_binding_count=45,matrix_cases=77,
            immutable_record_bindings=receipt['record_bindings'],archive_sha256=sha((FOLDER/'closed_log_binding_before.json').read_bytes()),
            unchanged_commands_sha256=sha((FOLDER/'commands.json').read_bytes()),
            limits='Only derived records repaired; original logs/validator/collectors/source/tests/fixture snapshots unchanged. No tests or package/GPU/platform/network/auth operations. Source tuple repair and root acceptance remain pending.')
with code.open('x') as handle: json.dump(record,handle,indent=2); handle.write('\n')
print(json.dumps(dict(status=record['status'],bindings_checked=len(comparisons),mismatches=bad,closed_logs=record['authoritative_log_sha256'],source_test=source),indent=2))
